explanation: GeneReport's study table and PathwayReport's headline, category headers and dataset blocks take what leads, the order and the counts from listCrossStudy; the per-view tierOf, TIER_RANK, byFdr, byTier and byTierThenEffect sorts are gone. Grouping by research area or category, folding, the quiet-areas line, the 3-track rule, the FDR-based "strongest" and the shared axes stay in the views. Both use the shared TierLabel; forestReport.css pairs .report-de-tier with .portal-tier so its size wins in any sheet order.
